title: Bulldozers soon moving in on 25-year-old shopping mall once home to Macy's as plans for new sports arena progress - NewsBreak
text:
By charlotte.edwards1@thesun.co.uk ,
13 hours ago THE Shops at Willow Bend in Plano, Texas, is facing a dramatic shake-up as plans to redevelop the ageing mall move forward.
The shopping center first opened its doors in 2001, becoming a major retail destination for North Texas .
Renderings show what the redevelopment will look like Credit: The Shops at Willow Bend Locals can still do mall walking at the site in a small area until early 2027 Credit: The Shops at Willow Bend After 25 years, large sections of the mall will be reduced to rubble.
According to local news outlet The Dallas Morning News , the mall will close and demolition will start in the coming months.
The malls website says it’s still offering indoor walking for locals.
It says: “Indoor walking continues at The Shops at Willow Bend as we prepare for the next phase of redevelopment.
“Beginning October 1, indoor walking will remain available in a limited area of the center and is expected to continue through early 2027.”
The mall was once home to department store giant Macy’s , which has since closed its doors.
Other major retailers have also departed and a Neiman Marcus at the site is set to close in 2027.
The redevelopment plans have been in the works for a while.
Back in 2025, The Shops at Willows Bend received approval from the Plano City Council on changes to the center’s transformational redevelopment project.
The proposed redevelopment, known as The Bend, could transform the property into a mixed-use destination.
Plans include a proposed arena for the Dallas Stars hockey team as well as new shops and restaurants.
